Bash(python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

df = pd.read_csv\('data/automated/optimizer_summary.csv'\)
df['target_str'] = df['target_point'].astype\(str\)

print\('=== N=25 Quick Test: Mean best selectivity across 4 targets ===\\n'\)
summary = df.groupby\('optimizer'\)['best'].agg\(['mean','min','max']\).sort_values\('mean', ascending=False\)
print\(summary.round\(4\)\)

print\('\\n=== Per-target breakdown ==='\)
pivot = df.pivot_table\(index='optimizer', columns='target_str', values='best'\)
print\(pivot.round\(4\)\)

print\('\\n=== When was the best found \(eval number\)? ==='\)
found = df.pivot_table\(index='optimizer', columns='target_str', values='best_found_at_eval'\)
print\(found.round\(0\)\)
")

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv\('data/automated/optimizer_summary.csv'\)
print\('=== Mean best selectivity across 4 targets \(N=25\) ==='\)
s = df.groupby\('optimizer'\)['best'].agg\(['mean','max']\).sort_values\('mean',ascending=False\)
print\(s.round\(4\)\)
print\(\)
print\('=== Best-found-at-eval \(mean across targets\) ==='\)
e = df.groupby\('optimizer'\)['best_found_at_eval'].mean\(\).sort_values\(\)
print\(e.round\(0\)\)
print\(\)
print\('=== Per-target breakdown ==='\)
for tp in df['target_point'].unique\(\):
    sub = df[df['target_point']==tp][['optimizer','best','best_found_at_eval']].sort_values\('best',ascending=False\)
    print\(f'Target {tp}:'\)
    print\(sub.to_string\(index=False\)\)
    print\(\)
")
